title: Cookie Policy
introduction: This Cookie Policy explains how this website uses cookies and similar technologies to improve functionality, enhance user experience, analyze website traffic, and support the delivery of freelance software development services. By continuing to use this website, you agree to the use of cookies as described in this policy.

sections.title: What Are Cookies
content: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit a website.
They help websites remember user preferences, improve performance, and provide insights into how visitors interact with the website.

sections.title: How Cookies Are Used
content: To ensure the website functions properly and securely.
To remember user preferences and settings.
To analyze website traffic and visitor behavior.
To improve website performance, usability, and overall user experience.
To detect and prevent fraudulent or malicious activity.

sections.title: Types of Cookies Used
content: Essential Cookies: Required for core website functionality and security.
Preference Cookies: Remember settings such as theme preferences and other user selections.
Analytics Cookies: Collect information about website usage, visitor interactions, and performance metrics.
Performance Cookies: Help identify technical issues and optimize website speed and reliability.

sections.title: Third-Party Cookies
content: Some features or services integrated into this website may use third-party cookies.
Third-party providers such as analytics, hosting, or embedded content services may collect information according to their own privacy and cookie policies.
This website does not control how third-party cookies are managed once they are placed by external services.

sections.title: Managing Cookies
content: Most web browsers allow you to control, block, or delete cookies through browser settings.
You can configure your browser to notify you when cookies are being used or to reject certain cookies entirely.
Disabling cookies may affect the functionality and user experience of some parts of the website.

sections.title: Analytics and Usage Data
content: Analytics tools may be used to understand how visitors interact with the website.
The information collected is generally aggregated and used to improve website content, functionality, and performance.
Analytics data is not used to personally identify individual visitors.

sections.title: Data Protection
content: Any information collected through cookies is handled in accordance with the website's Privacy Policy.
Reasonable measures are taken to protect data from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or misuse.

sections.title: Updates to This Cookie Policy
content: This Cookie Policy may be updated from time to time to reflect changes in legal requirements, technologies, or website functionality.
Any updates will be posted on this page along with the revised last updated date.

sections.title: Contact
content: If you have any questions about this Cookie Policy or the use of cookies on this website, please contact me through the contact information provided on this website.
